commit.message:
Catch ClassCastExceptions caused by incorrect Serde setup

Idea here is to give better feedback to the user when their Serde
setup is incorrect. Result is:

StreamsException: ClassCastException in processor node. Are your Serdes correct? Are default Serdes specified?

Vs

ClassCastException: class [B cannot be cast to class java.lang.String ([B and java.lang.String are in module java.base of loader 'bootstrap')
Improve error message, add unit test, move tests
Extend exception message to include explanation other than serdes
Add note for Produced.keySerde(WindowedSerdes.timeWindowedSerdeFrom(String.class)) for sink nodes
Match capitalisation for Serde and note actual error and process
Change to assertThrows, remove redundant test, change exception catch, remove unchecked
Update capitals in test to match node
